concept.title: Identifying Agreement Risk Using Intelligent Risk Management (Insights)

conbody.p: Intelligent risk management identifies risks during third-party paper import using artificial intelligence (AI)/machine learning (ML) and the risk rules you define. You can define risk identification rules using natural-language search technology and an extensible query builder. These risk identification rules are defined in CLM. During import, you can view the identified risks and take corrective actions.
